title: envlinks themepack v1
description: A URL-addressable colorscheme package for the envlinks trio (Windows Terminal, Neovim, pi agent). Explicit overrides win; anything missing is derived from the base16 palette. A themepack with only a palette is complete.

$schema.description: URL of this schema (enables editor validation/autocomplete).

name.description: Unique slug; matches the installed filename scripts/themes/<name>.json.

source.description: Upstream URL (palette repo, nvim plugin repo, or the URL this pack was imported from).

palette.description: base16 / Tinted Theming roles. Required unless nvim.spec, full pi theme, and full wt colors are all provided explicitly.

engine.description: mini-base16: generated colorscheme from the palette. plugin: full-fidelity nvim plugin spec (requires nvim.spec).

spec.description: Full Lua plugin spec table written to nvim/lua/plugins/colorscheme.lua (required when engine=plugin).

pi.description: pi agent theme overrides. Sparse colors are merged over palette-derived defaults; a full colors object with all 51 tokens is used as-is.

vars.description: Extra vars merged into the generated pi theme's vars (defaults to the palette).

colors.description: Token -> color (hex, var name, 0-255 index, or "" for terminal default).

wt.description: Windows Terminal scheme overrides merged over palette-derived defaults.

name.description: Display name inside Windows Terminal (defaults to themepack name).

colors.description: Sparse overrides for the 20 WT keys: background, foreground, cursorColor, selectionBackground, black, red, green, yellow, blue, purple, cyan, white, brightBlack, brightRed, brightGreen, brightYellow, brightBlue, brightPurple, brightCyan, brightWhite.
